space: source projected metres before common model scaling
rule: column=floor(x/1000),row=floor(z/1000); half-open cells [min,max), exact seam assigned east/south; regional mask outer edge retained with clamp to last interior cell. No longitude wrap within project.
lod: Rendering LOD aggregates immutable logical IDs, never changes identity.
coast: Coast/rivers cut cells freely. Raster data pixels and rendering patches are independent address spaces.
